audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 and Level 3 read Dr. Mundo in both layers while whys[1] says 'You favour level 2', whys[2] says 'You keep level 3', and spikes[0].text opens 'You dominate early'. The packet levelChart reads Zaahen for both, and the already-audited mirror flipped the same two rows to Zaahen as one atomic group.
audit.why: The mirror has already moved; leaving these two would make the two directions disagree on the same two rows, and mirror-fix.js would rewrite them anyway.
audit.corrected: Level 2 and Level 3 flipped to Zaahen as matched full+content pairs, ratings set to 6/10 (inverse of the mirror's 4/10). The other five rows already match the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heart Zapper is the tracked cooldown in roughly twenty fields with no duration, and the level-6 spike gives no number for Maximum Dosage.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s and Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s at every rank — the longest fixed ultimate cooldown you will meet in this lane, which makes a baited R the whole window.
audit.corrected: 16s written into breakdown.cooldowns alongside the stored-damage mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) His Q is called 'Infected Cleaver' in six content fields — the current name is Infected Bonesaw. (2) Goes Where He Pleases is described only as 'his passive eats your CC'; Riot's text says it resists the FIRST immobilizing effect, costs him health, and drops a chemical cannister he picks up to heal and to shorten the passive's own cooldown. (3) Heart Zapper is described as 'sustain + reset' when it actually STORES a portion of the damage he takes and heals him a percentage of it on the burst.
audit.why: Zaahen has two displacements — the Q recast knock-up and the W pull — and the first one is simply eaten. Knowing that turns 'his passive eats your CC' into a plan: spend the cheap one first, then zone him off the cannister so he does not get the heal back. And because Heart Zapper heals from stored damage, Grievous Wounds has to be on him BEFORE the burst, not applied after it.
audit.corrected: Infected Bonesaw corrected in all six fields (length-neutral swap); the cannister and the first-immobilise rule added to breakdown.cooldowns and late; the stored-damage heal and anti-heal timing added to breakdown.cooldowns; the Blunt Force Trauma auto-reset tell added to report[5].t.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in report[8].t, dosFull[1] and dontsFull[2], which is right for a champion healing from W, R and the passive cannister. What was missing was the TIMING, now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Infected Bonesaw 'costs him health' in three places. Riot's data lists cost 0 and the description does not mention a health cost.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo's abilities are health-costed in game, but that is not something this file can confirm, and needsResearch is empty by design.
audit.corrected: Left the claim exactly as written rather than remove a probably-true line; recorded in unverified.

notes: 'Infected Cleaver' is the pre-rework name and it appeared in six content fields; the swap to Infected Bonesaw is character-identical so every one fitted the band. The cannister half of his passive is the actionable detail nobody had written: he has to walk over it to get the heal, so zoning it is free value after your first knock-up is eaten.
